name: Vanderbilt County Park & Campground
evidence: Esri satellite 43.5935,-83.6593 (z17-z18 frames): RV loops on a bench ~9 m above (DEM 185 vs 176) a Saginaw Bay coastal-marsh arm ~120-160 m N across a brushy, partly treed slope; open bay ~500 m NW. No pad near water; county 'along the shoreline' is prose, no site map. View kept

name: Walnut Hills Family Campground by GatherGrounds
evidence: Esri satellite z19 at 42.8420,-84.0108: RVs parked on the NW loop's river-side row sit ~7-13 m from the Shiawassee River bank through a thin, open tree fringe (more ~25 m back); the swim-pond row (W side of pond) is also on-water. River is the main water. Operator site bot-walled

name: Woodland Park Campground
evidence: --AWH firsthand: every site is separated from the lake by a driveway. Esri satellite 46.6733,-85.9911 agrees: north row of pads sits behind the perimeter driveway and a ~40-60 m shore tree band, then a wide Lake Superior beach. Campspot 'Lakefront' type names don't override it

name: Eddy Park Campground
evidence: City site-dimension PDF (Camp-Site-Dimensions-2024) types RV lots 4-24 'Lakeside'. Esri Wayback 2018-08-15 z19 at 46.4834,-89.9452: parked RVs on the peninsula's outer loop sit ~10-20 m from Sunday Lake across open grass and a few trees, no road between. Leaf-off 2025 frame agrees

name: Big Bend Park
evidence: Pin (Campspot's coordinate) was in a pine plantation ~600 m N; park is on the SE point (OSM 'Big Bend Township Park'). Campspot per-site map: every RV site is inside a perimeter loop road, with a grass strip and docks between it and Hardy Dam Pond. Leaf-off Wayback 2021: units ~25-50 m back on a high bank. Engine sells 13 'Water View' sites

name: Pleasant Lake County Park & Campground
evidence: Jackson County per-site park map (DocumentCenter/View/7435): sites 1-60 sit in loops behind a private lake-house strip and road outside the park line; the shore is the day-use swim beach reached by stairs. Esri satellite z18 agrees (houses and trees between the loops and the lake)

name: Arbutus Lake State Forest Campground
evidence: DNR pin is the entrance at the county road ~650 m N; loop found on leaf-off Wayback 2019-04-24 (OSM camp_site agrees). Trailer loop runs on a hillside (DEM 259-274 vs lake 243); DNR says the lakeshore sites are tent-only with stairs. No site map, trailer pads not resolvable: default down

name: Big Bear Point State Forest Campground
evidence: Esri/Wayback z19 (2019, 2020, 2025) at 44.9420,-84.3862: sites line a track down a narrow treed point between Big Bear Lake and a marsh bay. One parked unit ~20 m from the south shore, but pads aren't legible under the pines. DNR's 'carry-in access at some sites' is prose, with no site map. Not upgraded
